label_space.name: emo-cause
label_space.description: Direct trigger, event, or appraisal evidence for the target emotion.

label_space.name: emo-context
label_space.description: Non-triggering discourse evidence that helps interpret the target emotion.

label_space.name: non-pair
label_space.description: Insufficient evidence for direct cause or contextual emotional support.

file_note: Label files are overlays keyed by split, dialogue_id, target_emotion_turn, and cause_turn. They do not include IEMOCAP utterance text or media.
